tile.name: IRC chat
tile.desc: Real-time chat in any IRC app

status.name: IRC server (ngIRCd)
status.note: chat in any IRC app, on :6667

network.says: IRC server. Anyone on the network can join. IRC has no accounts and no encryption. The server accepts at most 5 connections from one client address.

addon.title: IRC server (ngIRCd)
addon.summary: A small IRC server on TCP port 6667 with a #lobby channel, for chat in any IRC app. The page /irc.html shows how to join. It uses a few MB of memory.
addon.consent: The server answers every device on the network of the box on TCP port 6667. It has no IRC authentication. It has no encryption between the client and the box. The server hides client addresses from other users. It has no moderators. Add the IRC server?

checks.title: Operator
checks.says: The IRC server has an operator ([Operator]).
checks.why: Whoever has the operator password can disconnect users and change any channel. The password is in the configuration file.
checks.fix: Keep the configuration file readable by root and the IRC account only.

checks.title: Connection limit
checks.says: It has no limit on the number of connections.
checks.why: One client can open connections until the box runs out.
checks.fix: Set a connection limit in the IRC server's configuration.

checks.title: Connection limit per address
checks.says: The IRC server has no limit on the connections from one address.
checks.why: One address can take every connection.
checks.fix: Set a connection limit for each address in the IRC server's configuration.

checks.title: Client addresses
checks.says: The IRC server shows the address of each client to every other user.
checks.why: Other users can see where each person connects from.
checks.fix: Hide the addresses in the IRC server's configuration.

checks.title: Name lookups
checks.says: The IRC server looks up the name of each client.
checks.why: With no internet connection, each client waits for a timeout before it can register.
checks.fix: Turn off the name and Ident lookups in the IRC server's configuration.
